# openobserve_organization (Data Source)

Reads an existing OpenObserve organization by identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_organization" "default" {
  identifier = "default"
}

output "org_owner" {
  value = data.openobserve_organization.default.user_email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identifier` (String) Organization identifier to look up. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID, same as `identifier`.
- `ingest_threshold` (Number) Ingestion quota threshold.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `org_type` (String) Organization type.
- `search_threshold` (Number) Search quota threshold.
- `user_email` (String) Email of the organization owner.
